dispute.claim_text: The listing said the jacket was 100% genuine leather. What arrived has a label reading 100% polyester. It is not the item described.

evidence.text: Photo of the received item's care label: '100% polyester'.
Cardholder to merchant requesting a return; merchant declines and says all sales final.

labels.notes: Clear case. Documented material mismatch on the critical point: listing says genuine leather (ev_001), received item's label says polyester (ev_003). Cardholder attempted to return (ev_004); merchant's all-sales-final policy does not defeat 13.3, which overrides refund policy.
